newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Petronas says makes significant oil, gas discovery.
newsitem.headline: Petronas says makes significant oil, gas discovery.

text.p: Malaysian national oil firm Petronas said on Wednesday its exploration and production arm and Esso Production Malaysia have made a "significant" oil and gas discovery off eastern Terengganu state.
In a statement, it said the discovery was at the Irong field in Block PM-9.
"The well flowed at a maximum daily rate of 5,889 barrells of 47.6 degree API oil and 3.81 million standard cubic feet of gas from a single reservoir zone," Petronas said.
The Irong field is in water depth of 64 metres and is located about 212 km north-east of the oil town of Kertih.
It is also situated between the Tapis field to the east and the Iron Barat field to the west.
